events.title: Oasis's 'Definitely Maybe' Turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their seminal debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 32 years ago today, Oasis dropped their debut album 'Definitely Maybe'. The record that launched a thousand singalongs and a career that defined a generation. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place from August 15-18, 1969.

angles.name: Remembering Woodstock
angles.copy: 57 years since the legendary Woodstock Festival. Three days of peace, music, and a lineup that changed everything. Imagine being there!

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: On this day in 1977, the world mourned the passing of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: It's 49 years since we lost the King. Elvis Presley's music and legacy continue to shake, rattle, and roll through the decades. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Hip-hop legend Tupac Shakur passed away on September 13, 1996, after being shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering a voice that changed hip-hop forever. Tupac Shakur's impact on music and culture remains as powerful today as it ever was.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: A true guitar hero, gone too soon. Remembering Jimi Hendrix, whose revolutionary talent continues to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on September 26, 1969, in the UK.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: The album cover, the songs, the legacy. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' is 57 years old! Which track is on repeat for you?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon whose voice and attitude continue to command attention.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: You know the voice, you know the swagger. Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK Single Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon gave the world 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates with its powerful message of peace and unity.

events.title: The Original iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, changing how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: 25 years ago, the original iPod dropped and put '1,000 songs in your pocket'. It totally changed the game for music! What was your first iPod?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating over six decades of 007, from iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes. What's your favourite Bond film?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incredible life and music of John Lennon. His legacy lives on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that showed their incredible range. Which track stands out for you?
